uncertain: Table 4 p.12: Skin row IIVO value 0.8415 ± 0.129 is printed at the top of the continued table on p.13 (text extraction placed it in the Cod row); read visually from image.
Table 1 p.10: madelon listed with Source 'KEEL' although text says 14 LibSVM datasets (the 14 Libsvm-labelled rows are counted as the 14 modified ones; 28 KEEL includes madelon).
Plain SMOTE is not a baseline; smote fields null. SBO (SMOTEBoost) and SBAG (SMOTEBagging) are the closest SMOTE-based entries.
Underline marks (worst) read visually from image, p.12-13; ties like st24 have several underlined cells.
best_other_* is just the highest printed baseline value among the 7 group-1 columns; not an official winner claim.
notes: Per-dataset class counts (minority/majority) not printed; only #Ex, #Atts, IR. Table 1 abbreviations: used in Table 3/4 row labels. Datasets with first column names in Table 1 are as printed (e.g. 'yeast05679vs4', 'krvsk3vs11'). Other ensembles of group 2 (CBIS, SNGEIP, sNED) compared on AUC only using results from original papers (Tables 7-9, p.17; datasets there e.g. Glass6, not all in the 42). Also AUC table (Table 3, p.11) per-dataset exists; G-mean chosen per metric priority. Datasets uploaded to GitHub https://github.com/smallcube/HD-Ensemble (not fetched). Other proposed-variant: none.
